info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Points-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Points Retrieval API allows businesses to access and display customer loyalty points information. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can seamlessly integrate loyalty program data into their applications, providing customers with insights into their points balance and transaction history. Typical consumers include customer service platforms, mobile applications, and loyalty program management systems. This API is essential for enhancing customer engagement and optimizing loyalty program operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current loyalty points balance associated with a user's account. It provides important details about the user's rewards status and can be utilized for engaging further with loyalty programs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loyalty points. This body should contain the necessary parameters to specify the action of fetching loyalty points.

200.description: Returns the current loyalty points for the user.
